observations: The page number «XI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L31: the dash of «1—5» is printed in two pieces, 16 and 21 px long with a gap of 5 px, together 42 px, where the dash of «31—37» in the same line is one stroke of 45 px; a broken long dash, transcribed as one. L03 «Björnbo» is in the type of the text, not spaced; L12 «Björnbo» is spaced. L04 and N02-N03: the figures after M are lowered, M₁, M₂, M₃. L06: the r and v after the folio numbers are raised.
N02: the first e of «verschiedener» is printed upside down, ə; see the critical note.
Marks not transcribed: mid-height specks between «lichsten» and «Dank» (L18) and between «in» and «schwarz» (L21).

critical_notes.evidence: the first e of the word is printed upside down, a turned sort; the word is «verschiedener», of different hands, as «verschiedene Hände» in L03
